title: GEMglMaterialf
description: specify material parameters for the lighting model

messages.description: which face or faces are being updated
material parameter to set, e.g. GL_SHININESS or GL_DIFFUSE
value to set the material parameter to (GL_SHININESS takes 0 to 128)

arguments.description: which face or faces are being updated
material parameter to set, e.g. GL_SHININESS or GL_DIFFUSE
value to set the material parameter to (GL_SHININESS takes 0 to 128)

body: [GEMglMaterialf] calls glMaterialf() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glMaterial in the OpenGL reference.
